desc: Derive per-element contribution formula: x contributes x * sum over suffix subsets S of |S|!(N-1-|S|)! * 10^{sum_{y in S} len(y)}.
Group 1..N by digit length; compute c_e (counts) and V_e (value sums) per class e in {1..6}.
Reduce weights to beta integrals: W_d = N! * sum_k q_k/(k+1) with Q = P/(1+(10^d-1)t).
Implement P(t) coefficients p_0..p_N via the logarithmic-derivative linear recurrence Q P' = R P (order ≤6), using modular inverses of (m+1).
For each nonempty class d, divide P by (1+(10^d-1)t) in O(N), accumulate sum q_k*inv(k+1), multiply by N! and V_d.
Handle edge cases (N=1, empty classes, modulo 998244353) and precompute modular inverses 1..N+1.
